product_wide_rationale: Owns Concord development coordination and its separation from planning, repository review, merge, and predecessor evidence. CD-0213 amends planning and issue linkage. CD-0241 distinguishes eligible phase-local integration from main-branch review and merge evidence.
summary: goals.md owns Concord's own development route: agents build Concord outside its workflow until the measured switch point is proven, and this decision grants no earlier adoption authority. Linear MCP owns planning under CD-0213. Pull requests and required checks retain main-branch review and merge authority; CD-0241 defines eligible rapid-phase local integration evidence without waiving existing independent review.
title: Concord development coordination
